summaries.en: Understand-Anything transforms any codebase into an interactive knowledge graph, enabling developers to explore, search, and ask questions about their code. Its key insight is using graph-based representations to capture relationships between code components, making complex systems navigable. You can integrate it with AI coding assistants like Claude Code or Copilot to instantly visualize and query your project's architecture, accelerating onboarding and debugging.

summary_short.zh: s-ui 是一款专为 SagerNet/Sing-Box 代理设计的进阶网页面板，旨在简化 Hysteria、Shadowsocks、VLESS 等多协议代理的配置与管理。其核心优势在于通过统一直观界面，将复杂设置流程化，降低手动配置错误率。技术亮点包括原生多协议支持、实时流量监控及灵活规则调整。部署于服务器后，可集中管理节点、监控网络状态并动态调整策略，适合个人或小团队搭建稳定易维护的代理基础设施，无需频繁修改配置文件即可快速切换协议或更新规则，提升运维效率。

summaries.en: s-ui is an advanced web panel designed for managing SagerNet/Sing-Box proxies, simplifying the configuration of multi-protocol proxies like Hysteria, Shadowsocks, and VLESS. Its key strength lies in providing a unified, intuitive interface for complex proxy setups, reducing manual errors. You can deploy it to centrally manage proxy nodes, monitor traffic, and adjust rules in real time, making it ideal for personal or small-team proxy infrastructure management.

summary_short.zh: Skills 是一个面向 .NET 和 C# 开发的 AI 编码代理技能库，通过可复用模块化技能增强代理实用性。其核心将代码生成、测试、调试等常见任务封装为独立技能，支持按需组合调用，实现复杂工作流自动化。技术上强调组合性，开发者可像搭积木般自由搭配技能，定制专属开发助手。实际应用中，集成至 AI 代理后，可快速实现 .NET 项目脚手架搭建、单元测试自动生成或代码审查，是提升 AI 辅助 .NET 开发效率的开箱即用工具集。

summaries.en: Skills is a repository of reusable, modular capabilities that enhance AI coding agents for .NET and C# development. It provides pre-built skills like code generation, testing, and debugging, enabling agents to perform complex tasks reliably. The project emphasizes composability, allowing developers to mix and match skills for custom workflows. Practically, you can integrate these skills into your AI agent to automate .NET project scaffolding, unit test creation, or code review. It's a practical toolkit for boosting AI-assisted .NET productivity.

summary_short.zh: Forge是一个Python框架，用于构建自托管的多步骤智能体工作流，核心能力是让大语言模型调用工具并执行复杂任务。其技术亮点在于模块化设计：将工具定义、LLM后端（如Ollama、llama.cpp）和工作流逻辑解耦，开发者可灵活组合组件。例如，定义搜索和计算工具后，LLM能自动决定调用顺序。实际应用中，Forge适合构建本地AI助手，用于自动化数据检索、文档处理或代码生成，所有数据本地处理以保障隐私。用户可从单步工具调用逐步扩展为多步骤流程。

summaries.en: Forge is a Python framework for building self-hosted, multi-step agentic workflows with LLM tool-calling. Its key insight is a modular design that separates tool definitions, LLM backends (Ollama, llama.cpp, etc.), and workflow logic, enabling flexible composition. Use it to create custom AI agents that chain function calls, retrieve data, or automate tasks—all running locally for privacy and control.
